name: Recruit CRM
niche: AI ATS and CRM for recruitment agencies
notes: Site says: "Zapier, Make and a full open API" Site says: "Expand your reach by integrating with Recruit CRM and tapping into a global network of recruitment professionals." Pricing page lists per-user monthly plans ($95, $135, $215) with account-level credits. Homepage says a full open API exists but the pages read do not say how to obtain access, so api_status is omitted. No headquarters or parent company stated.

review.note: Homepage, pricing and integration pages read with HTTP 200; no headquarters, parent or API access method stated.
